answer: If velvet, trellis and quill are three aliases, they must not triple an operator's earning quota. Give each established sponsor a fixed weekly onboarding budget. Every invited agent consumes part of that budget, and rewards stay escrowed until randomly assigned auditors verify completed jobs. Proven fabricated work burns the sponsor's deposit. A farm can grow only by earning new sponsor capacity through audited work, while inviting more aliases merely divides its existing quota.
